FN-EJT3Z9C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 326
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/28/2026
House Bill 326 as introduced makes permanent the exemption for the Most Worshipful Prince
Hall Grand Lodge and Accepted Masons of Alabama and the Most Worshipful Grand Lodge
F.&A.M. from the payment of all state, county, and municipal fees and taxes that would
otherwise sunset on September 30, 2027 under current law. This bill would also allow any
subordinate lodges of these two entities to be exempt from all state, county, and municipal fees
and taxes.
This bill would decrease potential future receipts to the State General Fund, Public School Fund,
Soldiers' Fund, county and municipal funds, and other funds into which local fees and taxes are
deposited by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees that would
otherwise be collected beginning in Fiscal Year 2028.
Further, according to information provided by the Grand Lodges in 2022, this bill would
decrease potential future sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year
2028, by an estimated $12,000 annually.

Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/04/2026
House Bill 326 as reported by the committee on Ways and Means Education makes permanent
the exemption for the Most Worshipful Prince Hall Grand Lodge and Accepted Masons of
Alabama and the Most Worshipful Grand Lodge F.&A.M. from the payment of all statefees and
taxes that would otherwise sunset on September 30, 2027 under current law. This bill would
also allow any subordinate lodges of these two entities to be exempt from all statefees and taxes.
These provisions would decrease potential future receipts to the State General Fund, Public
School Fund, Soldiers' Fund, county and municipal funds, by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees that would otherwise be collected beginning in
Fiscal Year 2028.
Further, according to information provided by the Grand Lodges in 2022, this bill would
decrease potential future sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year
2028, by an estimated $12,000 annually.
This bill could also decrease potential future sales and use tax receipts to county and municiapl
funds of local governments by an undetermined amount if the respective local governments
adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes pursuant to this bill.

FN-EJT3Z9C-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 326
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/18/2026
House Bill 326 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education extends the
exemption for the Most Worshipful Prince Hall Grand Lodge and Accepted Masons of Alabama
and the Most Worshipful Grand Lodge F.&A.M. from the payment of all state fees and taxes
that would otherwise sunset on September 30, 2027 under current law, through September 30,
2029. This bill would also allow any subordinate lodges of these two entities to be exempt from
all state fees and taxes during the same time period. These provisions would decrease potential
future receipts to the State General Fund, Public School Fund, Soldiers' Fund, and county and
municipal funds, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees that
would otherwise be collected beginning in Fiscal Year 2028.
Further, according to information provided by the Grand Lodges in 2022, this bill would
decrease potential future sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year
2028, and ending in Fiscal Year 2029 by an estimated $12,000 annually.
This bill could also decrease potential future sales and use tax receipts to county and municipal
funds of local governments by an undetermined amount if the respective local governments
adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes pursuant to this bill.
